Topics and common questions

8

How do you protect the data used by your AI systems?

We implement stringent data security measures including encryption both at rest and in transit, rigorous access controls, and regular security audits. Our systems use the latest technologies to ensure that all data is handled securely, preventing unauthorized access and ensuring confidentiality.

What steps do you take to prevent biases in your AI models?

To mitigate biases, we employ diverse datasets during training and validate our models across different demographic groups. We also conduct thorough audits to detect and correct any biases that may arise, ensuring our AI systems are fair and objective.

Are your AI systems compliant with data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)

Yes, our AI systems are fully compliant with major data protection regulations like the GDPR in Europe and the CCPA in California. We ensure all data is processed legally, transparently, and with necessary user consents, providing users with rights to access, rectify, and delete their data.

How do you handle data breaches or security incidents involving AI?

In the event of a data breach or security incident, we have a robust incident response plan that includes immediate containment, thorough investigation, and timely notification to affected parties. We also take steps to mitigate any potential damage and prevent future occurrences.

Can third parties access the data processed by your AI systems?

We do not share or sell user data to third parties .
